	Arrowhead Recreation Area recently hosted the Trans New England, the Eastern Collegiate Cycling Conference and the Eastern States Cup Stan's Enduro Finals. 
	The Sugar River's many falls and steep drops generate hydro-powered industrial development. 
	The Wheel House, a full service, rider owned and operated bike shop is now located at the city-owned Arrowhead Recreation Area. 
	Investment in the mill district is just one way Claremont continues to reinvent itself. More adaptive reuse projects are underway. 
	Enjoy the variety of shops and restaurants on Pleasant Street in the City Center.
